dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're another one of those who wants to find out Lady Ningguang's secrets, are you? Unfortunately, I know no more than you do...

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang has never been one to let her guards get too close. I'm only in this post in the first place thanks to my cousin.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenhai
dialogues.text: Baixiao pestered her about the idea constantly, and even then she only agreed to it reluctantly...
